**What failure mode does this catch?**
Describe the structural risk this checklist item would help an auditor notice.

**Where does it belong?**
Which lens (Leverage Points / Feedback Loops / Emergent Behavior / Paradigm) or which existing section of `references/framework.md` / `references/domains.md` should this live under?

**Concrete example**
A real or realistic agent config/prompt/code snippet that would trigger this finding, and what the finding should say.

**Is this domain-specific or general?**
If it only applies to one domain (trading, sales, etc.), it probably belongs in `domains.md` rather than as a new framework.md section.
